headline:
Half of buyers over 70
aren't getting a mortgage.
[[They're writing a check.]]
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
takeaway: If you're financing in Broward, you're often bidding against a neighbor who isn't.

stats.label: 46% of buyers age 71 to 79 paid cash for their last home.
39% of buyers 61 to 70 did the same.
Only 3% of younger millennials paid cash.
